svg.aria-label: From config file to running components: load the file or URL, config.Parse (strict JSON, version, registry lookup, decode settings, Validate) into a blueprint, config.Check and CheckDatasets; every problem goes to Diagnostics. With errors, stop and print them all. Without, apranik check prints valid and exits, and apranik run calls builder.New, BuildOutbound, BuildRouter, BuildInbound and Activate.
svg.title: From config file to running components

g.text: each with a location such as
A port already in use fails at BuildInbound, so it is a startup error, not a first-connection surprise.
